output.question: Who are LinkedIn's main competitors?
output.answer: Microsoft, LinkedIn's parent, describes LinkedIn's competitors in its fiscal 2026 annual report (year ended June 30, 2026) by type rather than by name. The categories are online professional networks; recruiting, talent management and human resource services companies; job boards; providers of learning and development products and services; online and offline outlets that earn revenue from advertisers and marketers; and outlets that offer lead generation and customer intelligence and insights. The FY2025 10-K uses the same wording, so the list hasn't changed. These categories match LinkedIn's businesses: its network, Talent Solutions (hiring), Learning, Marketing Solutions (ads) and Sales Solutions (lead generation).

key_facts.fact: Microsoft's FY2026 annual report says LinkedIn competes with online professional networks; recruiting, talent management and HR services companies; job boards; learning and development providers; outlets that earn revenue from advertisers and marketers; and lead generation and customer intelligence outlets.
Microsoft's FY2025 Form 10-K uses the same competitor categories for LinkedIn.

passages.quote: LinkedIn faces competition from online professional networks; recruiting, talent management, and human resource services companies; job boards; companies that provide learning and development products and services; online and offline outlets that generate revenue from advertisers and marketers; online and offline outlets for companies with lead generation and customer intelligence and insights.

caveats: Microsoft's filings name only types of competitors, not companies. Any specific names, such as Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, Coursera or Meta, come from outside this source and were not checked here.

The FY2026 passage was read from Microsoft's online annual report (ar26) through a fetch tool that returned it in pieces; I joined those pieces into the quote above. I could not read the text of the FY2026 10-K PDF itself.

LinkedIn's own pre-acquisition 10-Ks (FY2011–FY2015) named Facebook, Google, Microsoft and Twitter as possible competitors in professional networking, and Xing and Viadeo as smaller international ones. That information is more than 10 years old.
